text:
Alex W: Heads-up — I sketched an onboarding + shadowing plan for new on-call folks next week. Trying to make the handoffs light but repeatable. Need a quick volunteer check so we can avoid coverage gaps.

Morgan T: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the shift windows? I may only be available afternoon PST.

Alex W: Sure — proposed windows (UTC):
- Mon/Tue: 06:00–14:00 primary / 14:00–22:00 secondary handover
- Wed/Thu: 14:00–22:00 primary / 22:00–06:00 secondary
- Fri: 06:00–18:00 primary on-call, 18:00–06:00 reduced rota (buddy on-call)

Jamie L: I can take Tue 06:00–14:00 primary and shadow Fri morning. Happy to do a 30m live runthrough Tue 05:30 UTC.

Sree N: I can cover Wed 14:00–22:00 primary. Also can pair with new folks on the runbook walk-through.

Pat G: Heads-up — I have a calendar block Wed 18:00–20:00 UTC for an external meeting. If I'm secondary for Wed night I may not be reachable for the first 10–15m.

Alex W: Noted Pat — we'll avoid making you secondary for Wed night. Need someone for Wed night 22:00–06:00 secondary (overnight) — volunteers?

Morgan T: I can be secondary Wed night but prefer to swap if a late outage requires long-term paging.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled on-call shift for Jamie L starts at 2026-03-24T06:00:00Z. Please acknowledge in thread with :wave:.

Jamie L: acknowledged :wave: — I'll do a quick runbook read before handover.

Alex W: Core runbook links: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-getting-started|On-call getting started>, <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/incident-response|Incident response>, <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/paging-rules|Paging rules>.

Alex W: Handoff template (use when you swap primary/secondary). Keep it short.
```
Handoff template:
- Current primary: <name>
- Active incidents: none / INCIDENT-ID (priority, customer impact, owner)
- Recent deploys: service/api @ <commit>
- Known flaky endpoints: /v1/generate (high latency 95th)
- Special notes: any expected maintenance, expired certs, infra tickets
```

Morgan T: One more ask — new on-callers should shadow two incidents (if possible) while being paired, not just sit in on a postmortem. Helps with paging muscle memory.

Alex W: Agreed. Plan: each new on-caller will be paired for 48h with a buddy (primary+secondary overlap) and must handle at least one paging drill or low-severity incident before solo.

Sree N: I can host a 45m walk-through Friday 15:00 UTC covering: where alerts come from, how to triage, how to escalate, and how to use the console traces.

Pat G: Can we add a checklist item to verify PagerDuty contact info and Slack notification routing? Had a case last quarter where a phone number was stale.

Alex W: Yep — checklist item added. Also adding quick verification steps: run `pd-svc status --user <your-username>` and confirm mobile push is enabled.

Jamie L: For the pairing, recommend we do a 15m pre-shift sync and a 10m post-shift debrief to capture any follow-ups.

Alex W: Good call. I'll post a calendar template and invite the buddies.

oncall-bot: Incident drill scheduled: 2026-03-25T14:00:00Z — drill lead: Sree N. This is a low-impact test page to exercise alert flow.

Morgan T: I'm in for the drill. Would be good to simulate a model-serve latency spike and practice fallback routing.

Alex W: Assigned so far — Mon/Tue primary: Jamie L, Tue secondary: Morgan T, Wed primary: Sree N, Wed secondary: Morgan T, Fri shadow/runbook: Pat G. Still need overnight volunteer Thu night (22:00–06:00 UTC). Anyone?

Pat G: I can do Thu night if needed but would prefer to swap with Morgan for a different night.

Morgan T: I can take Thu night but prefer to remain secondary Wed. Ok with that swap.

Alex W: Sweet — I'll update the schedule and send invites. If anyone spots a gap after invites, ping me. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
